content.comment_body: My [product_name] is new but it is asking for an LSC access password before I can transfer from [product_name] to [product_name].
This happens because password protection for LSC access has been enabled in the access control settings. If no new password has been set, the default password is [product_name].
Hello [user_name], What is the computer's IP address? (Check it in the Control Panel - Network settings)
How does the IP address relate to the password prompt for LSC access?

analysis.insight_summary: Users were surprised by a password prompt when transferring a program from the software to the hardware for the first time. The password protection feature in the software led to confusion, as there was an expectation that a new device would not require a default password. Additionally, the relationship between network configuration and the password issue was unclear to some users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipated a simple transfer from the software to the new hardware, without needing to deal with password prompts or default passwords.
